大型双发宽体家族。硕大的发动机和每侧六轮主起落架很有辨识度；-300ER 的机身: A large twin-engine widebody family. Look for the enormous engines and six-wheel main landing gear on each side; the -300ER is noticeably longer than the -200 series.
Dreamliner 家族。发动机后缘的锯齿形结构、后掠翼尖与飞行时的机翼曲线，: The Dreamliner family. Look for the chevrons around the engine exhausts, raked wingtips and the graceful wing flex in flight.
原 C Series 家族，采用五座并排客舱。小型喷气客机的尺寸，却有明显的后掠: Originally the C Series, with five-abreast seating. This small jet has distinctly swept wings and winglets.
A318、A319、A320 和 A321 组成的单通道家族。侧面辨认时可比较机: A single-aisle family comprising the A318, A319, A320 and A321. Compare fuselage length, doors and engines in side views; wingtips alone cannot distinguish neo from earlier variants.
空客双发宽体家族，客运型号常见经济舱为 2–4–2 布局。A330neo 使用新: An Airbus twin-engine widebody family, commonly with 2–4–2 economy seating. The A330neo has newer engines and wingtips; check the specific variant to distinguish passenger and freight roles.
新一代双发宽体家族，驾驶舱黑色窗框和流畅上扬的翼尖很醒目。-1000 比 -90: A modern twin-engine widebody family with distinctive black cockpit window surrounds and smoothly upswept wingtips. The -1000 is longer than the -900 and has a different main landing gear arrangement.
贯穿全机身的双层客舱、四台发动机和庞大的翼展，是最鲜明的识别点。实际座位数依航司: The full-length double deck, four engines and enormous wingspan make it unmistakable. Seating capacity depends on each airline’s cabin configuration.
737 Next Generation 家族。保持较低的机身与单通道布局，常见: The 737 Next Generation family retains a low-slung fuselage and single-aisle cabin, with CFM56-7B engines. Wingtip retrofits vary between aircraft and operators.
737 的新一代系列，采用 LEAP-1B 发动机及上下分叉的先进技术翼梢。判断: The newer 737 series uses LEAP-1B engines and split-tip Advanced Technology winglets. Identify a MAX using both engines and wingtips, rather than fuselage length alone.
支线喷气机家族，机尾两侧安装发动机，采用 T 形尾翼。CRJ-200、700 和: A regional jet family with engines mounted on either side of the rear fuselage and a T-tail. The CRJ-200, -700 and -900 differ in length and capacity.
Dash 8 家族中的较大型号。高翼布局、两台涡桨发动机及 T 形尾翼，是与喷气: The larger member of the Dash 8 family. High wings, twin turboprops and a T-tail distinguish it from regional jets.
双发涡桨支线飞机，采用高翼与 T 形尾翼。低速进近时可留意螺旋桨的动态，而不只追: A twin-turboprop regional aircraft with high wings and a T-tail. On approach, some propeller motion can add life to a photograph rather than freezing every blade.
机身写有 Congratulations，配合 Excellence 2026: Congratulations lettering accompanies the Excellence 2026 marking, while C-FIVM’s tail retains an employee-name theme. The name is based on text visible in the photos.
加拿大航空为米兰科尔蒂纳冬奥会与冬残奥会推出的加拿大队主题涂装，机身展示加拿大运: Air Canada’s Team Canada livery for the Milano Cortina Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games, featuring Canadian athletes on the fuselage.
华盛顿州立大学主题，采用校队的绯红与灰色，Horizon Air 的 E175: A Washington State University theme in the team’s crimson and grey, carried by a Horizon Air E175 operating under the Alaska Airlines brand.
